purpose: Audit the 578 nm clock Rabi-power discrepancy without fitting the atomic dipole or modifying the main diagram.

currentCalculator.powerConvention: Pure pi component; no split into sigma components
currentCalculator.independentSourceSupport: Compare separately with the rate-derived value from Xu2014. Agreement does not recover the old internal generating record.

experiment.powerDescription: Incident probe power; no full absolute calibration/error budget in the article
experiment.nominalFrequencyDefinition: 1/(2*t_pi) only; not a reported time-domain Rabi-oscillation fit

lattice.geometryBoundary: The quoted trap region is a geometric scale, not a measured full cloud distribution or absolute centring calibration.

linewidth.method: Lorentzian spectral fit; paper attributes broadening to clock-laser frequency noise

experiment.precisionBoundary: Power, waist and pi-time uncertainties/covariance and a matching flopping trace are not reported. Do not calculate a statistical experiment-versus-prediction significance from missing uncertainties.

constantsForMotion.source: Kroeze v2 Table2 p20; adopted only for the isolated motional scale check

strengthSources.locator: arXiv v1 pp.3-4, Eq.(2), TableI and free-atom result
strengthSources.definition: Hyperfine-induced E1 radiative clock decay of free 171Yb, F=1/2 to F=1/2
strengthSources.caveat: Not an uncorrected cold-atom trap lifetime, and not direct Rabi spectroscopy.

strengthSources.locator: arXiv PDF p.8 TableIV, 171Yb 3P0 to1S0, F1/2
strengthSources.caveat: No numerical uncertainty assigned from the table.

strengthSources.locator: arXiv v2 pp.4-5 Fig5 and zero-lattice intercept
strengthSources.definition: Natural clock-state lifetime from zero-lattice intercept Gamma0
strengthSources.caveat: Rate-to-dipole comparison treats Gamma0 as clock E1 dominated, with paper-described negligible BBR contribution. Finite-depth total decay and trap survival must not be substituted.

strengthSources.locator: PDF p24 Table9; references213 Siegel and214 Xu
strengthSources.definition: Adopted total radiative lifetime; not an additional independent measurement
strengthSources.caveat: Shares the above Xu/Siegel inputs; do not treat this recommendation as an independent third experiment.

xuTableI.boundary: These are reported correction factors, not new independent decay measurements. Adopt the reported final free-atom rate directly; do not apply the total correction again to a rate that has already had medium quenching removed.

angularDefinitions.dipoleFromDecayRateReturn: sqrt(sum_lower_m,q |d_q|^2)=dF/sqrt(2), not dF and not fixed pi

historicalTrace.oldRecord: v5.7 applied 5.30e-5 ea0 to every channel; v5.8 reinterpreted it as the sigma anchor and set dF=sqrt(3)*d_sigma approximately9.19e-5.

hypotheses.finding: The source explicitly says 1/e^2 waist radius200um. No permission to substitute a diameter or100um radius.
70nW is incident probe power in the same operating paragraph, not the7mW generated source output. A hidden throughput loss is not established.
Linear polarization is parallel to B and drives pi; no factor1/2 sigma power split is justified.

578nm reflectivity<1% excludes treating the reflected probe as a full equal-amplitude retro beam. A local +/-10% field bound is conditional on equal mode/waist; actual returned mode and phase are missing.
dF/sqrt6 for pi and dF/sqrt3 for sigma satisfy the total-rate sum rule. Current dF is independently compatible with Xu2014; the old source origin remains unknown.
With the stated1/e^2 radius, Gaussian beam-centre intensity is2P/(pi*w^2). Dividing it by2 to force agreement is not justified by the small quoted trap region.

Axial harmonic diagnostics quantify one effect, but radial temperature, actual misalignment, spatial distribution, anharmonicity and state-dependent populations are missing. Mean signed matrix element is not the fitted oscillation frequency.
18-20Hz is a measured spectral linewidth including interrogation response and noise. No calibrated noise spectrum or time-domain Rabi trace is available to infer a unique coupling correction.
